objective: negative Breslow Cox partial likelihood with T_j >= T_i

omics.RNA_global_baselines: outer-train median imputation -> metadata-verified log2(x+1) without clipping -> outer-train variance ranking -> top-512 -> standardization
omics.CNA_global_baselines: outer-train imputation -> nonzero/variance filtering -> top-256 -> standardization
omics.MCAT: six official groups; each token concatenates fold-local RNA and CNA symbol intersections; mutation unavailable
omics.MMPTrans-Hallmark: 50 official Hallmark groups; fold-local RNA-only pathway vectors and pathway-specific encoders; morphology outer-train Ch=16 GMM

pathology.train_sampling: deterministic by seed, epoch and patient from per-patient pool
